dialogue.content: おはようございます。カウンセラー役です。時間になったら始めたいと思いますので本日もよろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.English: Good morning. I'll be playing the role of the counselor. We'll begin when it's time, so I look forward to working with you today.

dialogue.content: お願いします！
dialogue.English: I look forward to it, thank you.

dialogue.content: おはようございます。本日はご相談にお越しいただき、ありがとうございます。まず初めに性別と年齢を教えていただけますか？
dialogue.English: Good morning. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. First, could you please tell me your gender and age?

dialogue.content: 女性　30歳です！
dialogue.English: I'm a 30-year-old woman!

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日のご相談は、どのようなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。本日のご相談はどのようなことでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you. What would you like to discuss today?

dialogue.content: 結婚してるんですが、旦那が全然家事を手伝ってくれなくて。
dialogue.English: I'm married, but my husband doesn't help with the housework at all.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね、それはしんどいですね、、ご結婚してどのくらい経ちますか？
dialogue.English: I see, that must be tough. How long have you been married?

dialogue.content: 3ヶ月ほどですが、同棲もいれるともう2年は経ちます。共働きなので、私が後に帰宅することもあるのですが、それでも家事はほとんど私です。
dialogue.English: About three months, but if you include the time we were living together, it's been two years. We both work, and sometimes I get home later, but even so, most of the housework falls on me.

dialogue.content: そうなんですか、同棲を始めたころからあまり家事は手伝ってくれなかったのでしょうか？
dialogue.English: I see. Has he not been helping much with housework since you started living together?

dialogue.content: そうです。でも最初の頃はとくに気にしてなくて、最近私の仕事が忙しくなってきたのもあって、それを見ても旦那は家事は女の仕事ってスタンスで、帰ってきたらゲームなりグダグダしたりで
dialogue.English: That's right. I didn't mind it much at first, but lately my work has gotten busy, and even seeing that, my husband has the attitude that housework is a woman's job. When he gets home, he just plays games or lounges around.

dialogue.content: そのような状態なんですね、、ちょっとイライラしますよね、それは。貴方も疲れて帰ってきて、もー手伝って！！って叫びたい状態だとは思いますが、旦那さんに家事の件をもう少し手伝ってほしいと伝えたことはありますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so that's the situation. That must be frustrating. I imagine you come home tired and just want to shout, “Help me already!” Have you ever told your husband that you'd like him to help more with the housework?

dialogue.content: ほんとにそんな気持ちです。伝えたことは何度もあります。言った時だけ洗い物少しやってた程度です。今までやってきたから大丈夫でしょ！って感じで流されます。
dialogue.English: That's exactly how I feel. I've told him many times. He might do a few dishes right when I say something, but that's it. He just brushes it off, saying something like, “You’ve been doing it all this time, so it’s fine, right?”

dialogue.content: なるほど、旦那さんはあなたの訴えをあまり真剣に受け止めてくれてない感じなんですね？旦那さんに直してほしいなと思うところは家事を手伝う以外にありますか？
dialogue.English: I see, so it feels like your husband isn't taking your concerns very seriously. Are there other things you'd like him to change, besides helping with the housework?

dialogue.content: きっとこれから増えていくんだろうなって思いますけど、今思うのは私が帰り遅くなった時くらいは簡単な食事を用意していてもらえるくらいにはなってほしいです。
dialogue.English: I'm sure the list of things I'd like him to change will grow, but for now, I just wish he could at least prepare a simple meal for me when I get home late.

dialogue.content: 疲れて帰ってきた時のゲームしながはご飯頼む。って言われるのが1番きついです。
dialogue.English: The hardest part is when I come home exhausted and, while he’s playing games, he tells me to order food.

dialogue.content: そうですよねえ、、それはないですね、、感情爆発しちゃいそうになりますよね、、義理の実家のお母さんとお父さんの関係は見ていてお父さんはあまりお手伝いしないかんですか？
dialogue.English: I can imagine... That's really not okay. It must make you feel like you're about to explode. Looking at the relationship between his mother and father, does it seem like his father doesn't help out much?

dialogue.content: お義母さんは専業主婦だったので、お義父さんの役割は働く、稼ぐって見事に分かれてたかもです！それを見て育ったから今があるって感じですかね？
dialogue.English: My mother-in-law was a stay-at-home mom, so my father-in-law's role was clearly defined as working and earning money. Perhaps he grew up seeing that, and that's why things are the way they are now?

dialogue.content: うーん、それもあるかもしれませんが、でもそれではあなたが困ってしまいますからね、、考えを改めていただかないといけないですよね？少しでも、、
dialogue.English: Hmm, that might be part of it, but that puts you in a difficult position... He needs to reconsider his way ofthinking, doesn't he? Even if it's just a little.

dialogue.content: 逆に、貴方のご両親はどんな感じでしたか？お父さんはお母さんのお手伝いをまめにする方でしたか？
dialogue.English: On the other hand, what were your own parents like? Was your father someone who diligently helped your mother?

dialogue.content: そうですね。2年の同棲でずっと家事をやり続けてきたから相手もそれが当たり前になってしまっているので、それもいけなかったのかなって思ってます。
dialogue.English: That's right. Because I've been doing all the housework for the two years we've lived together, he's come to take it for granted, so I think maybe that was my mistake, too.

dialogue.content: うちは共働きです！
dialogue.English: My parents both worked!

dialogue.content: 家事はどっちも出来て、臨機応変って感じでした。母がメインでしたけど
dialogue.English: Both of them could do housework, and they handled it flexibly. My mother was the main one, though.

dialogue.content: そこに、たぶんちょっと感覚のずれが旦那さんとあなたにあるのかもしれませんね。どっちがいいとか悪いとかではないですが、、
dialogue.English: Perhaps there's a bit of a difference in perspective between you and your husband on that point. It's not about which is right or wrong, though...

dialogue.content: どっちがいいか悪いかではないですが、旦那さんとあなたの中にそこの見てきた自分の両親の姿に少し感覚の違いがあるのかもしれませんね？どう思われますか？
dialogue.English: It's not a matter of right or wrong, but perhaps there's a slight difference in perception between you and your husband based on the images of your parents that you both grew up with. What do you think?

dialogue.content: 結構ずれてそうですね。とくに旦那は同棲までは実家で生活していたので
dialogue.English: It seems like there's quite a big difference. Especially since my husband lived with his parents until we moved in together.

dialogue.content: 今思うと家事出来ないとかじゃなくした事ないんですよね。
dialogue.English: Now that I think about it, it’s not that he can’t do housework—he’s just never done it.

dialogue.content: なるほど、1人で暮らしたことがないので家事の大変さもあまりわからないし、やったこともないかもしれないと思われたんですね
dialogue.English: I see. So you’re thinking that since he’s never lived on his own, he doesn't really understand how demanding housework is and has probably never even done it before.

dialogue.content: それは聞いてみないとわからないですけど、やっていないでしょうね笑子供がもし産まれた時なんか思うともっと大変そうになりそうなのでほんと今のうちって思ってきました。
dialogue.English: I won't know for sure unless I ask, but he probably hasn't, haha. When I think about what would happen if we had a child, it seems like it would get even harder, so I've come to feel that we really need to sort this out now.

dialogue.content: それはそうですね、、子供がうまれたらほんともっと大変になりますね、、1度状況をまとめてもよろしいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: That's true... it really will be much harder once a child is born. Would it be alright if I summarize the situation for a moment?

dialogue.content: はい、ストレスすごい溜まるのか、旦那もそこで変わるのか、わからないですけどお願いします！
dialogue.English: Yes, I don't know if I'll just get incredibly stressed or if my husband will change then, but please go ahead!

dialogue.content: ええ、そうですね、変わるきっかけになるように一緒に考えましょう！2年3か月ともに生活をしているが共働きなのに旦那さんが家事を手伝ってくれない。何度も手伝ってほしいと訴えたが、その時は洗い物をしてくれるがやはり習慣にはなっていない。たまに遅く帰ったときんは簡単な食事でもいいのでできているとありがたいなと思っている。ただ旦那さん自身が1人で生活をしたことがないので、家事ができるかどうかわからないということでよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: Yes, that's right. Let's think together about how we can create an opportunity for change! You've been living together for two years and three months, and even though you both work, your husband doesn't help with the housework. You've asked him many times for help, and while he might do the dishes at that moment, it doesn't become a habit. You'd be grateful if he could prepare a simple meal when you get home late. However, since your husband has never lived alone, you're not sure if he's even capable of doing housework. Is that a correct summary?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます！はい、そんな感じですね。とりあえず簡単な食事を用意できるくらいの腕をつけてほしい。今はそれを目標にしたいなって思います！
dialogue.English: Thank you! Yes, that's about right. For now, I'd like him to acquire the skills to prepare a simple meal. I think I'd like to make that our goal for now!

dialogue.content: 了解です！それでは、簡単な食事をできることを目標にしてみましょう。その前に、家事ってゴミ出しや洗濯物など多々ありますがそのあたりは旦那さんお手伝いしてくれてますか？
dialogue.English: Understood! Then, let's set a goal for him to be able to make a simple meal. Before that, housework includes many things like taking out the trash and doing laundry. Does your husband help with any of those things?

dialogue.content: はい！洗い物は先程も伝えたように言ったらやる時ありますが、なかなか習慣にはなってくれないです。出勤は旦那が先なので、ゴミ出しはしてくれてますね！
dialogue.English: Yes! As I mentioned earlier, he sometimes does the dishes if I ask him to, but it never becomes a habit. My husband leaves for work before I do, so he does take out the trash!

dialogue.content: ゴミ出しはしてくれると聞いて、それはまだ、光を感じました！本当に手伝う気がなければゴミ出しさえしてくれないと思うので。ちなみに旦那さんの得意料理はありますか？
dialogue.English: Hearing that he takes out the trash, I feel a glimmer of hope! If he truly had no intention of helping, I don't think he would even do that. By the way, does your husband have any dishes he's good at making?

dialogue.content: 私の中でゴミ出しは簡単すぎて家事に入れてなかったですが、そう思うと救われますね。作った事は一回もないって言っていいくらいですね。当然インスタントや冷凍食品を扱う知識はあります。笑
dialogue.English: In my mind, taking out the trash was too simple to count as housework, but thinking of it that way is a relief. I can safely say he has never cooked a single meal. Of course, he knows how to handle instant and frozen foods. (laughs)

dialogue.content: 大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: Is everything okay?

dialogue.content: なるほど、、、ゴミ出しがカウント外でしたか。すこしだけ旦那さんのポイントが上がったことを願います!!冷凍食品は扱えるということでしたら、1度週末にでも一緒に作ろうよ、と声をかけてみるというのはいかがですか？めんどくさいといわれるかもしれないけれど、とりあえず、もし子供出来たらそんなこといぅってられないよ？とはっぱをかける
dialogue.English: I see—so taking out the trash didn’t even count for you. I hope his points went up just a bit! Since he can handle frozen foods, how about inviting him to cook together one weekend, saying, “Let's make something together”? He might say it’s a hassle, but you could give him a little nudge by saying, “If we have a child, you won’t be able to say that, you know?”

dialogue.content: ゴミ出しがポイントになったことは良かったです！！
dialogue.English: It's great that taking out the trash has become a positive point!

dialogue.content: 週末に、冷凍食品で一緒に作ってみる。めんどくさいといわれるかもしれないですが
dialogue.English: How about trying to make something together with frozen foods on the weekend? He might say it's a hassle, but...

dialogue.content: めんどくさいと言われたら、子供ができたらそんなこと言ってられないよとはっぱをかけてみるのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: If he says it’s a hassle, how about giving him a nudge by saying, “You won’t be able to say that once we have a child”?

dialogue.content: （すみません、先ほど急に送信できなくなりました。メッセージ届いていますか？）
dialogue.English: (Sorry, I suddenly couldn't send anything for a moment. Are my messages getting through?)

dialogue.content: 一緒に作ってみるのは良いかもしれませんね。今更って感じもしますがやってみます。それか私が晩御飯インスタントとかでもいけちゃうので、最初そこから入ってみようかなとも思いました！さすがに用意してくれるかな？って思ってます。頑張ってみようと思います。
dialogue.English: Cooking together might be a good idea. It feels a bit late in the game, but I'll try it. Alternatively, since I'm fine with instant food for dinner myself, I thought maybe I could start from there. I'm hoping he would at least prepare that much for me. I'm going to give it a try.

dialogue.content: 届いてます！大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, I'm receiving them! It's okay.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございます）そうですね、少し旦那さんの垣根を低くしてみるのも1つだと思いますよ、インスタントでもおいしいのあるから、これだったら温めるだけだから悪いけど私が遅くなった日はこんな感じでお願い！とかいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.English: (Thank you.) Yes, I think lowering the bar a bit for your husband is a good approach. There are some delicious instant options, so how about saying something like, “This one just needs to be heated up, so I'm sorry to ask, but on days I get home late, could you please handle dinner like this?”

dialogue.content: そして用意してくれた日には、めーいっぱい大げさに助かる！！といってみてください。旦那も子供もほめて伸ばすのがコツだとおもいますよ、、
dialogue.English: And on the days he prepares something, try telling him with great exaggeration how much of a help it is!! I think the key with both husbands and children is to praise them to help them grow.

dialogue.content: 私基準で考えてしまっていたかもです。そこは反省ですね。それいいですね。そんな感じで伝えてみようかなって思います。作るのに慣れてきたら先に食べられてそうですけど笑頑張ってみたいと思います！
dialogue.English: I might have been judging things by my own standards. That's something for me to reflect on. That's a great idea; I think I'll try communicating it that way. Once he gets used to making food, he'll probably eat before I get home, haha, but I'll give it my best shot!

dialogue.content: 褒めることも大事ですね。わかりました、ありがとうございます！
dialogue.English: Praising him is important, too. I understand, thank you!

dialogue.content: 貴方がご自分でご自分の基準で少しハードルを上げていたという点に気が付くのはとても素直な方なんだろうと思いました！！多少汚くできてもそれは目をつぶってあげてくださいね！先に食べられていても、まずは作ったことに旦那さんに丸をぜひあげてみてください。
dialogue.English: The fact that you realized on your own that you might have been setting the bar a little high based on your own standards tells me you're a very honest person! Even if it's a bit messy, please try to overlook it. And even if he eats before you get home, for now, please give him full credit just for the act of making something.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。そうしてみますね。色々とお話し聞けて良かったです！
dialogue.English: Thank you. I'll try doing that. I'm glad I had the chance to talk about all of this!

dialogue.content: こちらこそご相談おいでいただきありがとうございましたそろそろ相談の終了の時間が来てしまいましたが、本日のご相談はこのあたりで大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.English: Thank you as well for coming in for a consultation. Our time is almost up; are you comfortable with ending our session here for today?

dialogue.content: はい。終了で大丈夫です！
dialogue.English: Yes, it's fine to end here.

dialogue.content: (お疲れ様でした😊)
dialogue.English: (Thank you for your time today 😊)

dialogue.content: 旦那さんが家事を習慣的に手伝ってくれることを祈ります!!でも急に人は変われないので少しずつ焦らず行きましょう！
dialogue.English: I hope your husband will start to help with housework habitually! But people don’t change overnight, so let’s take it one step at a time without rushing.

dialogue.content: （ネットの調子が悪くすみませんでした）おつかれさまでした
dialogue.English: (My apologies for the internet connection issues.) Thank you for your time today.
